newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Expatriates living in Jeddah outnumber Saudis. Study shows 51 percent of Jeddah residents are foreigners.
- Saudi company wins a 2.5 million riyal contract to manufacture pay phones for a South American customer.
- Riyadh-based holding company Fama plans to invest 45 million riyals to expand a date plant.
- Saudi Ceramics Company to approve raising its capital to 200 million riyals from 150 million riyals.
- Around 174 tonnes of gold worth $3 billion were sold in local Saudi markets in 1996.
